hook.name: QuotronStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for w<SYM>/USDG stock pools on Ink that overrides the LP fee to zero and collects a configurable hook fee on the USDG side of each swap via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap return delta, distributing proceeds between a per-pool LP vault pot and a shared terminal pot used for automated stock buybacks and dividends. Pools must be registered by the factory before initialization.
